root_cause.text: In the xfrm input async resume path, `dev_put(skb->dev)` was called immediately upon re-entry before the skb reached `transport_finish`, allowing the device to be freed while it was still used by the `NF_HOOK` in `transport_finish`, leading to a use-after-free race condition.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the `dev_put` from the async resumption entry at `net/xfrm/xfrm_input.c:506-507` and instead drops the reference after the `NF_HOOK` call in `transport_finish` functions (`net/ipv4/xfrm4_input.c`, `net/ipv6/xfrm6_input.c`), using a saved device pointer to avoid referencing `skb->dev` after it may be consumed.
